```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)

df_list <- readRDS("data/export.rds")

# Create plot theme
  my_plot_theme <- theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 10, b = 20)),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 9),
      axis.line  = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
    )
  
```

## 📈 SURGERIES and PROCEDURES per YEAR

📌 The following charts illustrate the overall volume of surgeries and procedures **performed annually**, highlighting the yearly distribution and productivity trends across the analyzed timeframe.

```{r}
#| label: table_surg/proc_per_year
#| echo: false

df_rep_year <- df_list[[2]]

df_rep_year |>
  rename(
    "Surgeries (running)" = S_cumul,
    "Surgeries (delta)" = S_diff,
    "Procedures (running)" = P_cumul,
    "Procedures (delta)" = P_diff
  ) |>
  kbl(align="c")|>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = "striped", 
    full_width = FALSE,      
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  column_spec(2:7, width = "15%")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_surg_per_year
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

ggplot(
  data = df_rep_year,
  aes(x = Year)
) +
  geom_bar(
    aes(y = Surgeries),
    stat = "identity",
    fill = "steelblue2",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = Surgeries,
      label = Surgeries
    ),
    vjust = -0.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name ="",
    breaks = seq(
      min(df_rep_year$Year),
      max(df_rep_year$Year),
      by = 1
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "",
    limits = c(0, max(df_rep_year$Surgeries) * 1.1),
    breaks = seq(0, max(df_rep_year$Surgeries) * 1.1, by = 50),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "SURGERIES per YEAR (",
      min(df_rep_year$Year),
      "-",
      max(df_rep_year$Year),
      ")"
    )
  ) +
  my_plot_theme
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_proc_per_year
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

ggplot(
  data = df_rep_year,
  aes(x = Year)
) +
  geom_bar(
    aes(y = Procedures),
    stat = "identity",
    fill = "steelblue2",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = Procedures,
      label = Procedures
    ),
    vjust = -0.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name ="",
    breaks = seq(
      min(df_rep_year$Year),
      max(df_rep_year$Year),
      by = 1
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "",
    limits = c(0, max(df_rep_year$Procedures) * 1.1),
    breaks = seq(0, max(df_rep_year$Procedures) * 1.1, by = 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "PROCEDURES per YEAR (",
      min(df_rep_year$Year),
      "-",
      max(df_rep_year$Year),
      ")"
    )
  ) +
  my_plot_theme
```

## 📈 SURGERIES and PROCEDURES as LEAD SURGEON

📌 The following charts break down the proportion of surgeries and procedures performed **specifically as the lead surgeon each year**, reflecting the evolution of primary surgical responsibilities over time (excluding total summary metrics).

```{r}
#| label: table_surg/proc_lead_per_year
#| echo: false

df_rep_lead <- df_list[[3]]

df_rep_lead |>
  kbl(align="c")|>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = "striped", 
    full_width = FALSE,      
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  column_spec(2:7, width = "15%") |>
  row_spec(nrow(df_rep_lead), bold = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(nrow(df_rep_lead), italic = TRUE)

df_rep_lead <- df_rep_lead |>
  head(-1) |>
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    `S_Lead (%)` = as.integer(gsub("%", "", `S_Lead (%)`)),
    `P_Lead (%)` = as.integer(gsub("%", "", `P_Lead (%)`))
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_surg_lead_per_year
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

ggplot(
  data = df_rep_lead,
  aes(x = Year)
) +
  geom_bar(
    aes(y = `S_Lead (%)`),
    stat = "identity",
    fill = "steelblue2",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = `S_Lead (%)`,
      label = paste0(`S_Lead (%)`, "%")
    ),
    vjust = -0.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "",
    breaks = seq(
      min(df_rep_lead$Year),
      max(df_rep_lead$Year),
      by = 1
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "",
    limits = c(0, max(df_rep_lead$`S_Lead (%)` * 1.1)),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "SURGERIES as LEAD SURGEON (",
      min(df_rep_lead$Year),
      "-",
      max(df_rep_lead$Year),
      ")"
    )
  ) +
  my_plot_theme
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_proc_lead_per_year
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

ggplot(
  data = df_rep_lead,
  aes(x = Year)
) +
  geom_bar(
    aes(y = `P_Lead (%)`),
    stat = "identity",
    fill = "steelblue2",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = `P_Lead (%)`,
      label = paste0(`P_Lead (%)`, "%")
    ),
    vjust = -0.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "",
    breaks = seq(
      min(df_rep_lead$Year),
      max(df_rep_lead$Year),
      by = 1
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "",
    limits = c(0, max(df_rep_lead$`P_Lead (%)` * 1.1)),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "PROCEDURES as LEAD SURGEON (",
      min(df_rep_lead$Year),
      "-",
      max(df_rep_lead$Year),
      ")"
    )
  ) +
  my_plot_theme
```

## 📈 PROCEDURES per PLACE

📌 The following chart illustrates the distribution of surgeries and procedures performed **across different hospitals**, highlighting the comparative volume and activity levels per medical facility.

```{r}
#| label: table_surg/proc_per_place
#| echo: false

df_rep_place <- df_list[[5]]

df_rep_place |>
  kbl(align="lcccc")|>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = "striped", 
    full_width = FALSE,      
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  column_spec(1:5, width = "20%") |>
  row_spec(nrow(df_rep_place), bold = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(nrow(df_rep_place), italic = TRUE)

df_rep_place <- df_rep_place |>
  head(-1)
```

Legend:

- CCLM = "La Madonnina" clinic, Milano

- ICH = "Istituto Clinico Humanitas" - "Humanitas Ressearch Hospital", Rozzano (MI)

- IOG = "Istituto Ortopedico Galeazzi", Milano

- MLC = "Alessandro Manzoni" Hospital, Lecco

- PFH = "Piccole Figlie Hospital", Parma

- POLI = "Fondazione IRCCS Ca' Granda - Opsedale Maggiore Policlinico", Milano

```{r}
#| label: plot_surg_per_place
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

ggplot(
  data = df_rep_place,
  aes(x = reorder(Place, -`Surgeries (n)`))
) +
  geom_bar(
    aes(y = `Surgeries (n)`),
    stat = "identity",
    fill = "steelblue2",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = `Surgeries (n)`,
      label = `Surgeries (n)`
    ),
    vjust = -0.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    name = ""
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "",
    limits = c(0, max(df_rep_place$`Surgeries (n)` + 250)),
    breaks = seq(0, max(df_rep_place$`Surgeries (n)`) + 10, by = 250),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "SURGERIES per PLACE"
  ) +
  my_plot_theme
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_proc_per_place
#| echo: false
```

## 📈 TOP 15 PROCEDURES

📌 The following chart presents the **15 most frequently performed surgical procedures**, highlighting the primary clinical interventions and their relative distribution over the analyzed period.

```{r}
#| label: table_top_15_procedures
#| echo: false

df_rep_top15 <- df_list[[6]]

df_rep_top15 |>
  select(-Short) |>
  kbl(align="cccl")|>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = "striped", 
    full_width = FALSE,      
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  column_spec(1:3, width = "10%")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_top_15_procedures
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

df_rep_top15 <- df_list[[6]]

ggplot(
  data = df_rep_top15,
  aes(
    x = reorder(Proc, -n),
    y = n)
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "steelblue2",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    vjust = -0.5, 
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    name = ""
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name="",
    limits = c(0, max(df_rep_top15$n)*1.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "TOP 15 ICD-9 PROCEDURES",
    caption = "Short description of ICD-9 procedures taken from CMS.gov"
  ) +
  my_plot_theme
```
